name: Foundation Phantom MK-1
summary: Phantom MK-1 is a full-size biped from San Francisco startup Foundation, aimed at heavy industry and defense. It is reported at 5 ft 9 in and 176 lb with a 44 lb payload and eight cameras instead of LiDAR. Foundation holds US military research contracts and sent two units to Ukraine for testing in February 2026.
highlights: $24 million in US Army, Navy and Air Force research contracts reported.
Two units sent to Ukraine in February 2026 for logistics and reconnaissance testing.
caveats: Price is a reported company figure, not a public list price.
Military use cases are early-stage testing.

sources.title: Foundation Future Industries wins $24M Pentagon contracts for humanoid robot soldiers
